args.lesson: Fact (2026-11-10): the Freelancer.com public API (api/projects/0.1/projects/active?query=...&full_description=true) returns dated, budgeted, explicitly paid buyer requests without login, HTTP 200. It is a reproducible primary source of paid demand, unlike seller-dominated HN/n8n threads and agency careers pages. 64 active fixed-price 'csv' projects; the closest data-cleaning fit (GBP 20-250) had 111 bids within hours; many CSV-tagged jobs are personal-data lead lists (excluded). Dependent: every bid needs a founder-authorized marketplace identity (BOUNTY-SUBMISSION-ELIGIBILITY); no qualifying candidate now. Conclusion: demand exists but cold bidding is crowded and identity-gated; do not draft bids without an identity. Reconsider when an identity is designated: then filter API for <15 bids, posted <6h, non-personal file-in/file-out cleaning. Used 2/6 fetches; query must be narrow (loose query 0/20 relevant).
